name: turkushan-auth
description: Self-hosted login portal (forward auth) for your subdomains behind Nginx Proxy Manager. People register their own account, you approve who may open which site in the admin panel, and one login works on all subdomains (SSO cookie). Per site you choose: approval required or open to any logged-in user, and whether a verified email is required. Single container, SQLite database in /data, no extra services. Includes an admin panel with a ready-to-paste NPM config per site, email verification and password reset via any SMTP provider (Resend recommended), and Discord notifications. Guide: https://github.com/turkushan490/turkushan-auth/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md

ports.name: Web port
ports.description: Port Nginx Proxy Manager uses to reach the portal.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: Public URL of the portal, e.g. https://auth.example.com

variables.name: ADMIN_USER
variables.description: Admin account created on first start.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Admin password: at least 6 characters, with 1 capital letter and 1 symbol (e.g. ! @ # ?).

variables.name: COOKIE_DOMAIN
variables.description: Optional. Cookie domain shared by all protected subdomains. Empty = derived from APP_URL (auth.example.com gives .example.com).

variables.name: PORTAL_INTERNAL_URL
variables.description: Optional. How Nginx Proxy Manager reaches this container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3010. Filled into the nginx snippets the admin panel generates.

variables.name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
variables.description: IPs/CIDRs of your proxy. Client IP headers are only trusted from these. Default covers Docker networks.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the app runs as (100 = users).

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Optional (min 32 characters). Empty = generated once and stored in /data/secret.
